mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_tasks (task_id, model_name, provider_account_id, task_status) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{modelName}, #{accountId}, #{taskStatus}) AS new_row ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_status = new_row.task_status
mapper.select:
SELECT t.task_id, t.model_name, t.provider_account_id AS account_id, a.account_name, t.task_status, DATE_FORMAT(t.created_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS created_time FROM model_tasks t INNER JOIN provider_accounts a ON a.id = t.provider_account_id
ORDER BY t.created_time DESC, t.task_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
